attrs.evidence: Two attacks, both reproduced against the shipped R5.2 gate before anything was edited. The first is ASR-ELIM-TYPED's. The second is subtler and had gone unnoticed for a round: §1 checked that every defeater an argument NAMED was relevant to it, which is a rule about the entries present and no rule about the ones absent, so removing two live undermining doubts from ARG-LED-C9-MEDIATED-SURFACE left the gate green. Registered as INC-R52-REVERSE-INDEX-DRIFT. The stored arrays are now gone from every argument record and the index is computed from the defeater targets.
attrs.prior_art: MOS-DERIVED-EQ, this project's own rule, applied to the assurance layer. Fable R5.2 F1; GPT-5.6 accept/implement.
attrs.statement: A defeater's lifecycle label — open, eliminated, terminated, sustained — is COMPUTED from the canonical edges. A record stores only its `disposition`, which is the part no edge derives. Argument-local defeater lists are a derived reverse index; any stored copy must equal the derivation.
